The '''SIS Surveillance Droid''' was a model of [[Surveillance droid/Legends|surveillance droid]] manufactured by [[Taptronics]]. They were simple units intended to supplement organic security forces. The main role of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was to notice criminal activity and report it to [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]].<ref name="MF" />
